root_cause: The historical reconciliation workflow and registry were unscoped shared executable paths, so a backend-only control-plane recovery activated unrelated portal, website/browser and automation lanes. The longer exact-head validation window repeatedly allowed moving main to make a green candidate behind.
prevention: Explicitly classify control-plane workflows on their owned lane.
Explicitly classify control-plane configuration on its owned lane.
Regression-test the complete change bundle, not just individual files.
Do not activate website, portal or automation gates without a changed path owned by those lanes.
